regime.label: Dealer short gamma at every strike while downside insurance rolls down to 940 - the 960 put wall is an accelerant, not a floor
evidence: -15,783 total net GEX with no zero crossing anywhere on the 940-1150 ladder: dealers are short gamma across the entire chain, so there is no gamma flip to reclaim and hedging amplifies moves in both directions.

-5,225 net GEX at 960 is the single most negative strike in the chain and it sits exactly on the 3,206-contract put wall 31.1 points below spot - a break of 960 forces dealers to sell with the move rather than cushion it.

702 contracts of 940 put OI appeared from zero today on 368 lots at 16.18% IV, the richest put in the chain, while 950/960/970 put OI fell 83/106/107 - protection being rolled down, not closed (total OI still +546 vs 2026-11-21).
13.62% ATM IV sits in the 89th percentile of this series' 47-session range (10.57-14.54) yet eased -0.92 pt from Friday's 14.54 peak: premium is historically rich but no longer expanding.

S50Z26.today_summary: 991.1 on the Dec future, -1.5 on the day, 28.9 points below the 1020 max-pain anchor and 31.1 above the 960 put wall. Put flow led at a 1.18 volume ratio against 0.86 standing OI, and the day's real build was 702 new 940 puts at 16.18% IV while 950-970 put OI shed 296 contracts. Net GEX is negative at every strike (-15,783 total, -9,411 within 20 points of the 990 ATM), so dealer hedging amplifies rather than dampens. The 940-960 shelf is where the chain's short gamma is concentrated.
what_changed: 940 put OI opened from 0 to 702 on 368 lots at 16.18% IV - a new tail strike, the clearest Vol2Vol confirmation in the chain.
ATM IV eased -0.92 pt to 13.62% from Friday's 14.54% peak while spot held flat at 991.1 (-0.3 pt), the first vol give-back of the seven-session slide.
Net GEX deepened again to -15,783 from -14,491 on 2026-11-21, extending a short-gamma build that is now 15x the -1,026 reading of 2026-11-14.
1060 calls added 183 OI on 239 lots, the only material upside build, against 296 contracts of put OI leaving the 950-970 strikes.
S50Z26.five_day_thesis: The decisive event was five sessions ago: ATM net GEX flipped from +1,874 on 2026-11-17 to -5,353 on 2026-11-18 as the future gapped 1025.2 to 1007.6, and it has only deepened since, to -9,411 today. Across that window spot fell 16.5 points to 991.1 while max pain drifted only 10 points lower to 1020, so price has walked 28.9 points away from its anchor with IV expanding 12.48% to 13.62% - the max-pain failure signature, which argues against fading back toward 1020. The near-money put wall has been pinned at 960 since 2026-11-18 while the near call wall migrated down 1050 to 1030, compressing the structure's working range to roughly 960-1030. Put OI grew 1,928 contracts (+11.3%) and call OI 1,209 (+5.8%) over the same five sessions, so this is accumulation of insurance, not an unwind. What is new today is that the insurance is being written below the wall rather than at it.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 980 / 950
strategies.rationale: Buys the 13.00% IV 980 put and sells the 15.55% IV 950 put, so the structure is long the 940-960 short-gamma pocket while financing itself with the richest wing in the chain instead of paying for it.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit, approx 7.7 points at 13.0 ask / 5.3 bid (approx 6.9 at mids). Max gain 30 - debit, approx 22 points below 950. Breakeven approx 972.
strategies.invalidation: A reclaim of 1010, the 25-delta call and the first strike where net GEX turns positive (+334).

strategies.name: Call credit spread 1020 / 1050
strategies.rationale: Sells the 1020 max-pain strike 28.9 points above spot at a 0.18 delta while IV sits in the 89th percentile - this expresses that price does not round-trip back to the anchor, which is the max-pain-failure read rather than a fade toward the pin.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = 30 - net credit, approx 25.6 points at 6.1 bid / 1.7 ask. Max gain approx 4.4 points. Short-vol payoff is negative-skew, so size it small.
strategies.invalidation: A close above 1030, the near call wall at 1,651 OI.

strategies.name: Put debit spread 970 / 940, armed only on a close below 960
strategies.rationale: The squeeze-continuation leg: with -5,225 net GEX at 960 dealers must sell into a break of their own largest put strike, and today's 702-contract 940 build marks where that flow is already hedged to.
strategies.defined_risk: Max loss = net debit, approx 6.2 points at 10.0 ask / 3.8 bid. Max gain 30 - debit, approx 23.8 points below 940.
strategies.invalidation: A close back above 970, the 25-delta put the protection was rolled down from.

S50Z26.prediction: 991.1 sits in a 960-1030 structural range with dealers short gamma throughout, so expect wider daily ranges than the 8.51-point 1-sigma suggests and directional follow-through rather than mean reversion. Bias is neutral-to-lower while price holds below 1010: a close under 960 hands the move to dealer selling into the chain's deepest short-gamma strike, with the fresh 940 put OI marking the next shelf. A reclaim of 1010-1020 on expanding call volume invalidates the downside read and would put the 1020 max-pain anchor back in play.
S50Z26.risk_note: Educational analysis only - not trade advice, and no instruction to execute anything. SET50 options are European and cash-settled on the SET50 index, with no physical delivery, so the dealer-hedging mechanics behind pinning and max-pain gravity are structurally weaker here than for share-settled single stocks: treat 1020 as a tendency, not a target. Defined-risk is not risk-free - the capped max loss on each structure above does occur, and short-vol payoffs are negative-skew (small frequent gains, rare large losses), so survival depends on position size. Deep-ITM IV prints in the feed are unreliable (960 call 25.06%, 1020 put 7.34%); no claim here rests on them. The 2026-11-24 snapshot carried null price/IV and zero volume, so all one-day deltas are measured against 2026-11-21.
